Six questions make the model readable
Each term answers a different question.
A grant defines authority. An assignment connects it to a recipient.

Who is acting, and whose human authority supports the request?

The human identity; actor type is user.
The person or program making this request.
An umbrella term—not another record or field.
Agent and service account are proxies
In our model, neither supplies independent authority.
Automated actors are not first-class members of authorization teams.

The human whose authority bounds the request.
The association and delegation must be established.
Subject identifies the human; actor identifies the caller.

A narrower selection inside the enclosing boundary.

Maya can perform explicitly authorized management.
